_comment: Open issues that verify-build.mjs reports as notes instead of failures. Each entry must be removed when its issue is fixed: verify-build fails if a listed issue no longer occurs. Never add an entry to make CI pass without an owner-approved reason and a tracking ID. History: the 3 missing Class 12 notes PDFs (P1-4) were resolved in phase-1b-fixes by hiding their links; the missing files are tracked in docs/MISSING_ASSETS.md.
